business_process: Treasury, payments, and bank file transfer
description: Daily cash positioning; wires; ACH batches including Finance's daily collection file; positive pay decisions for all five entities
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Positive pay exceptions must be decided by each bank's daily cutoff or checks return; about $3.5 million of payments and $220,000 of Finance ACH collections move each business day; an outage is when payment fraud slips through
manual_workaround: Bank portals reachable from any managed laptop with bank hardware tokens; Treasurer and CFO approve in the bank portal; phone instructions to the relationship manager with callback; upload ACH and positive pay files directly in the bank portal
dependent_third_parties: Operating banks; treasury management system vendor; ISPs
quantified_operational_impact: About 140 outgoing payments and 2 ACH files a day; manual bank-portal work takes about 3 times longer
quantified_regulatory_impact: A missed Finance collection file posts borrower payments late and triggers late fees in error (see BP-16)

description: Biweekly payroll for 600 employees; payroll tax deposits; garnishments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The payroll file is due to the provider 2 business days before payday, so the MTD is 72 hours although payroll runs every two weeks; about $1.4 million per cycle; a missed payroll harms employees and retention
manual_workaround: Payroll provider's service team reruns the prior payroll, and differences are trued up next cycle
dependent_people_or_facilities: VP of Human Resources; payroll team (3)
quantified_operational_impact: 600 employees across 5 employers; about 70 hourly timecard changes per cycle
quantified_regulatory_impact: Late payroll tax deposits draw penalties

description: Invoice capture and coding; vendor master changes; payment runs for all five entities
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Vendor terms are mostly net 30; Supply's key suppliers put accounts on credit hold after about a week late; bank-detail changes must never be rushed during an outage
manual_workaround: Hold non-urgent payments; pay critical suppliers by wire from the bank portal with CFO approval and callback verification

business_process: Month-end close, consolidation, and lender and sponsor reporting
description: Subsidiary feeds to the ERP; consolidation; monthly lender compliance reporting; sponsor reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Close takes 8 business days; the credit agreement sets monthly and quarterly reporting dates; slipping more than 5 days compresses lender reporting
manual_workaround: Manual journal entries from subsidiary system reports; consolidation in spreadsheets from ERP exports
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-04 (integration service, reporting warehouse); SYS-02
quantified_operational_impact: Close team of 10; each lost day adds about 2 days of overtime work

description: Email, files, chat, and phones for all five entities, including the Home Services dispatch phone lines
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every process uses email or files; Home Services dispatch phone lines run on the suite's phone service; customers and vendors cannot reach the group
manual_workaround: Personal phones and printed contact lists for the incident team; call forwarding of dispatch numbers to dispatchers' mobile phones; bank and vendor portals used directly
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite provider; suite backup vendor
quantified_operational_impact: All 600 employees; about 260 Home Services calls a day in summer arrive on suite phone lines

description: New hires, transfers between subsidiaries, terminations, and employee records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Hiring can continue on paper for a few days, but access removal for departures must not wait
manual_workaround: Paper onboarding packets; HR phones the service desk to disable departing users' accounts
quantified_operational_impact: About 12 hires and 12 departures a month
quantified_regulatory_impact: Access removal for terminations must continue (POL-02)

business_process: Group health plan administration (plan sponsor functions)
description: Appeals support, stop-loss reimbursement filings, weekly claim funding, and vendor oversight for the self-funded plan
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The TPA and PBM pay claims on their own platforms, so members keep receiving care; sponsor work is weekly funding, appeals, and stop-loss filings
manual_workaround: TPA and stop-loss portals from any managed laptop; weekly claim funding by wire from the bank portal
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,100 covered persons; weekly claim funding about $160,000; about 20 appeals a year
quantified_regulatory_impact: Plan PHI is covered by the HIPAA Security Rule and Breach Notification Rule; a delayed appeal decision can miss plan deadlines

description: Board and audit committee materials; data rooms; acquisition integration
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deal timelines and board dates can move by a week; data room confidentiality matters more than availability
manual_workaround: Encrypted email to directors; data room vendor's own access
dependent_third_parties: Board portal and data room vendor

description: Order entry at 3 branch counters, by phone, and on the contractor portal; pricing; invoicing; daily sales feed to the ERP
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $216,000 of sales per business day; contractors buy elsewhere after a few hours; about 40% of lost counter sales are not recovered; the distribution system vendor holds order data
manual_workaround: Printed price list and paper tickets for will-call orders; card terminals keep working on their own (point-to-point encryption); key orders by phone to branch managers
dependent_third_parties: Distribution system vendor; ISPs; card processor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Counter staff at Branches 1-3; inside sales
quantified_operational_impact: About 900 orders a day across 3 branches and the portal

description: Receiving and put-away; picking with handheld scanners; loading and delivery by 22 trucks from the distribution center
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 300 deliveries a day; contractor crews stand idle when deliveries slip; scanners depend on the scanner management server at HQ and the distribution system
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists printed from the last order export; manual load sheets; phone confirmation with crews
dependent_systems: SYS-12; SYS-08 (scanners); SYS-10 (scanner management server); SYS-09
dependent_third_parties: Distribution system vendor; ISP at the distribution center
dependent_people_or_facilities: Distribution center staff (110); Supply distribution center
quantified_operational_impact: About 300 deliveries and 1,800 order lines picked a day

description: Purchase orders and supplier electronic orders; replenishment planning (AI-006 demand forecast)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Stockouts of fast-moving items start after about 3 days without replenishment
manual_workaround: Phone and email orders to the top 20 suppliers from printed reorder reports

business_process: Call handling and dispatch, including emergency calls
description: Customer calls, scheduling, and dispatch for South, Central, and North; after-hours calls answered by the AI voice agent (AI-005) and the on-call manager
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Loss of cooling in Florida summer heat is a health risk for elderly customers, and gas-smell calls need immediate safety instructions; about $104,000 of service revenue per business day
manual_workaround: Paper dispatch board; dispatch numbers forwarded to dispatchers' mobile phones; after-hours line rolls to the on-call manager; emergency calls first
dependent_third_parties: Field-service system vendors (2); AI voice agent vendor; telecom carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Dispatchers (12); South, Central, and North shops
quantified_operational_impact: About 260 calls and 180 jobs a day in summer, including about 25 no-cooling emergency calls a day in July
quantified_regulatory_impact: None beyond consumer protection; safety is the driver

description: Technicians receive jobs, equipment history, and pricing on tablets; invoice and take payment on site
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Technicians need equipment history and refrigerant and gas appliance records to work safely; invoicing can be back-entered
manual_workaround: Paper work orders and invoices; card readers keep working on their own; equipment history by phone from the shop

description: Nesting and scheduling on the plant server; cutting on 4 CNC plasma tables; forming on 6 press brakes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $48,000 of production per business day; Home Services installations and contractors wait for ductwork; the nesting programs live only on the plant server
manual_workaround: Run repeat parts from programs stored on the machine controllers (about 30% of volume); manual layout for urgent jobs
dependent_third_parties: Machine vendors (remote support); nesting software vendor
quantified_regulatory_impact: None; a tampered machine program is a worker-safety and equipment issue (impact_safety)

description: Customer orders, order confirmations, and shipping paperwork (ERP order module)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Orders can be held for two days before customers move to competitors
manual_workaround: Orders taken by phone and email on paper; handwritten bills of lading

description: ACH collections; payment posting; borrower calls; payoff quotes; servicing for the bank partner from 2027-01
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Collections must post on the due date or borrowers are charged late fees in error; about $220,000 is collected per business day; from 2027 the bank partner relies on servicing accuracy
manual_workaround: Borrowers pay through the servicing vendor's phone payment line; manual posting from bank reports; late fees suspended during the outage
quantified_operational_impact: About 11,800 active loans; about 560 payments a business day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Borrower account errors; FTC Safeguards Rule and state notice duties if customer information is affected

description: Applications, credit decisions (including AI-002 automated decisions), adverse action notices, and funding
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 45 applications a day; Home Services sales wait for financing approval; notice-of-action clocks keep running
manual_workaround: Manual underwriting on paper for urgent applications; funding by wire from the bank portal
quantified_operational_impact: About 45 applications and 20 fundings a business day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Notice of action taken within 30 days after a completed application (12 CFR 1002.9(a)(1)(i))

description: Complaint intake and response; license reporting; adverse action and fair lending monitoring
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Complaint responses and reports can wait a few days if logged
manual_workaround: Paper complaint log; responses from templates
quantified_regulatory_impact: State licensing reports (dates set by the licensing regulator)
